text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond scores a brilliant victory. And yet, she doesn't look very happy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her legs got tired toward the end of the race and she wasn't able to run her best. She leaves the race discouraged that her performance wasn't becoming of an illustrious runner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She didn't have enough energy for the race because she had to run to the racecourse after we got stuck in traffic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond suspects everything was due to her family jinx.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, she picks herself up and declares her intent to break her family's jinx at the upcoming Japanese Derby.
